title: Mercedes eSprinter becomes electric ice-cream truck
summary: UK ice cream van manufacturer Whitby Morrison has unveiled a fully electric ice cream van based on the Mercedes-Benz eSprinter platform. The vehicle was designed from the ground up as an all-electric ice cream van and has successfully completed the individual vehicle approval process.

title: Early switch to EVs delivers significant climate benefits
summary: Continuing to drive a functional combustion-engine car rather than replacing it with an electric vehicle is not necessarily the more climate-friendly option. A US study finds that switching to an electric car reduces emissions in 92 per cent of the modelled scenarios.

title: Xing Mobility introduces immersion-cooled batteries for ships
summary: Xing Mobility is launching two immersion-cooled battery systems specifically for maritime applications. The modular Immersio XM25 solution is adaptable to different ship types, while the Immersio CTP, with its cell-to-pack architecture, is designed to offer particularly high energy density in a compact space.

title: Solaris to deliver 22 more electric buses to Romania
summary: Solaris has received another order from Romania. The transport operator of the city of Sfântu Gheorghe has ordered 22 electric buses in three different lengths. Delivery is scheduled for the second half of 2027.

title: New Zealand offers $21 million in loans for EV chargers
summary: New Zealand has opened a second funding round for public charging infrastructure as it targets 10,000 charge points by 2030. Around NZ$21 million will be available as zero-interest loans covering up to half of eligible project costs.

title: Honda reportedly taps Tata Technologies for multi-energy platform
summary: Honda has reportedly commissioned Tata Technologies to develop a new vehicle platform. The future platform will support multiple powertrains, giving the Japanese automaker the flexibility to adapt to changing market dynamics.

title: Tesla recalls 20,000 EVs over headlight glare
summary: Tesla is recalling 20,349 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles in the US because their low-beam headlights exceed permitted luminous intensity levels in certain areas. The carmaker had sought to avoid the recall, but the US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) rejected its request.

title: Kia EV3 starts at under $30,000 in the US
summary: The Kia EV3 has finally reached the US, with prices starting at $29,890 before destination charges. The compact electric SUV offers up to 321 miles of EPA range and comes with a NACS charging port as standard.

title: VW ID.3 Neo starts at £33,080 in the UK
summary: Volkswagen has announced UK prices for the revised ID.3 Neo, with orders opening on 13 August. Three battery sizes are available, offering up to 390 miles of WLTP range, while all variants qualify for the UK's £1,500 Electric Car Grant.

title: Elephants make short work of charging station
summary: Occasional vandalism of charging stations is nothing new, but one Chinese charge point operator likely wasn't expecting an elephant to be the culprit when one of its charging towers was knocked over late one night.

title: Mitsubishi to launch ASX VR-e in Australia and New Zealand
summary: Mitsubishi has revealed a new compact EV called ASX VR-e for Australia and New Zealand. iPhone maker Foxconn's automotive subsidiary, Foxtron, has developed the new EV as part of an agreement with the Japanese brand jointly announced in May 2025.

title: Logistics firm Pflaum deploys 30 new eActros 600 trucks
summary: The German logistics company Pflaum is significantly expanding the battery-electric share of its truck fleet. The company has received 30 Mercedes-Benz eActros 600 vehicles and will now gradually integrate them into its operations. By 2030, three-quarters of the fleet are set to be powered by alternative drives and fuel types.

title: GM exits Samsung SDI battery cell joint venture
summary: General Motors is once again withdrawing from a joint venture for the production of battery cells. Samsung SDI is acquiring GM's stake in SynergyCells and the joint plant in New Carlisle, Indiana, making it the company's first fully owned cell factory in North America.

title: Wales grants decade-long rates relief for EV charging sites
summary: Electric vehicle charging bays and forecourts in Wales will receive 100 per cent relief from non-domestic rates until 2036. The Welsh government says the measure should support investment in charging infrastructure, particularly in underserved areas.

title: Gas prices are about to go even higher. Here’s how to use an e-bike to save money
summary: If you are like most people and currently drive a gasoline-powered car, the pain is about to become even worse. US government officials have warned that gas prices are expected to rise further as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz continue to disrupt the global oil supply. While we can’t control geopolitical events, we can control how much gasoline we actually need to buy. And that’s where e-bikes come in.

title: Kia EV3 prices and range revealed, starting at $30,000
summary: Kia’s affordable electric SUV is now on sale in the US, starting at $29,890. The 2027 Kia EV3 has an official EPA-estimated driving range of up to 321 miles.

title: China sales numbers are in: EVs up while everything with an engine collapses
summary: The structural collapse of gas car sales has continued in the world’s largest auto market, with July numbers showing that the only type of vehicle doing well is pure battery-electric cars, while sales of every other type of vehicle continue to drop precipitously for months on end.

title: Cadillac will hand-build a custom Escalade IQ for you, but it will cost an extra $55,000
summary: Cadillac is giving buyers the opportunity to customize the flagship electric SUV through its bespoke program, which will be hand-built in Michigan. The catch? It’s not going to be cheap.

title: Tesla recalls 20,000 Model 3/Y for headlights that are too bright
summary: If you’ve ever been driving at night and felt like the car behind you had too-bright headlights, that car might have been a Tesla, and it might have felt that way because its lights broke the rules.

title: Tesla files for $10.1B ‘Project Crystal Sun’ solar factory in Texas
summary: Tesla has filed for a $10.1 billion solar cell factory in Fort Bend County, Texas, under the codename “Project Crystal Sun,” according to a tax-incentive application posted by the Texas Comptroller. The filing pegs the plant at 9,712 permanent jobs, roughly 3,050 acres near Richmond, and commercial production starting in the first quarter of 2029. It’s the largest US manufacturing investment Tesla has ever put on paper.

title: Ukraine debuts mine-resistant all-wheel drive combat electric motorcycle
summary: Electric motorcycles have already proven themselves in military roles thanks to their quiet operation, but Ukraine has just taken the concept several steps further. The country’s newly approved MUL.E electric motorcycle is more than just another battery-powered dirt bike – it’s an all-wheel-drive machine specifically designed for battlefield logistics, stealth operations, and even traversing certain minefields.

title: Oil giant rips out gas pumps for BYD’s 1,500 kW EV chargers
summary: Sinopec, China’s biggest fuel retailer, just gutted one of its Shanghai gas stations and swapped the pumps for BYD’s 1,500 kW flash chargers. And this wasn’t a case of bolting a couple of chargers onto the edge of the forecourt. Sinopec pulled the underground gasoline tanks out of the ground and turned the whole site into an EV-only charging hub.

title: The 2027 Audi Q6 e-tron delivers more driving range than expected
summary: Audi’s midsize electric SUV drove further than advertised. The 2027 Audi Q6 e-tron has an EPA-estimated driving range of up to 301 miles, but in the real world, it traveled even further.
